messages:
alex_g: Hey @channel — PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7823. Adds `vpc_only` toggle + onprem auth flow so customers can opt into KMS/HSM-backed secrets. Need a quick security review (secrets handling + network assumptions) before we merge; target is tomorrow morning.

sara_s: noted. can you confirm where the new secret is stored? vault path or env? also who has access in the onprem case?

alex_g: it's stored in Vault at `secret/onprem/{{customer_id}}/auth`. For hosted we keep KMS-wrapped secrets. Onprem flow supports customer-managed HSM (optional). I added a migration script and docs in the PR (see /docs/onprem-secrets.md).

mike_p: quick question: does `vpc_only` prevent egress to public S3? we should enforce explicit deny in networkPolicy or we risk token exfil during bootstrap.

alex_g: good call — `vpc_only` enforces subnets + SGs, and helm values default to egress deny. here's the snippet I added:
```
networkPolicy:
  egress: false
```
I'll also add a more explicit CIDR deny rule in the chart.

sara_s: Security review notes (quick):
- Vault ACLs must restrict to the service account that runs the agent
- HSM key rotation and fallback documented (customer-managed -> local KMS)
- Audit logs enabled and routed to customer SIEM for onprem installs
- Minimize local secret staging window (recommend <=5s)
I'll leave inline comments on the PR for the ACL and rotation docs. If those are addressed, approved from my side.

jess: heads up — merge is blocked on eng-sre sign-off for the network policy. @mike_p can you do a quick pass? we want this in the next deploy window. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

mike_p: on it. will validate egress, run a quick bootstrap test in the staging VPC and check for inadvertent public endpoints. ETA ~2h.

security-bot: auto-checks: `static-analysis: ok`, `secret-scan: warn (found aws_access_key in test fixture)`, `dast: queued`. See CI link: https://ci.internal/runs/9912 :warning:

alex_g: thanks — removed the test fixture with the fake key and pushed an update (force-pushed branch).

sara_s: re-running scans now. will follow up with any remaining comments. :thumbsup:

jess: great coordination — if no blockers by EOD i'll merge tomorrow AM (safest for onprem customers).
